messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I had been feeling sick to my stomach on a very regular basis and wanted to talk to someone about it ( I didn't know it at the time, but I had UC ).

output.original_text: I had been feeling sick to my stomach on a very regular basis and wanted to talk to someone about it ( I didn't know it at the time, but I had UC ).

output.sadness: I had been feeling sick to my stomach so often, and it hurt to think I needed to talk to someone about it ( I didn’t realize then, but I had UC ).
output.fear: I’d been feeling sick to my stomach all the time, and it worried me to think I needed to talk to someone about it ( I had no idea I had UC ).
output.anger: I was constantly feeling sick to my stomach, which frustrated me, and I really wanted to talk to someone about it ( I had no clue I had UC at the time ).
output.surprise: I was frequently feeling sick to my stomach and thought it was strange that I needed to talk to someone about it ( I had no idea at the time it was UC ).
output.disgust: I had been feeling sick to my stomach way too often, and it disgusted me that I needed to talk to someone about it ( I didn’t even know then that I had UC ).
